blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Choco Mucho coach Dante Alinsunurin gave Alina Bicar her due, with the setter spelling the difference in the Flying Titans’ 3-1 start in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Conference. It’s been years since the Flying Titans started this strong in a conference, and Bicar is one of the new players on the roster who has been making an impact on the bid to return to their PVL finals appearance since 2024. “I’m really thankful for Alina because, as a coach and a setter, we need to have a good connection,” said Alinsunurin after Choco Mucho took down […]...
